title: Do not infer arbitrary-FPT hardness from ordinary polynomial security
statement: The packed residual source reduces an assumed computable FPT native learner to a uniform subexponential NC1-PRF distinguisher by clocking the computation of f(2p+9) and choosing a slowly growing qualified packing p. The separately unconditional probability-rank/cutwise shadow obstruction uses a near-uniform diagonal marginal and strict diagonal dominance. These are distinct computational-premise and representation-class boundaries; neither is a universal sample lower bound.
